[[File:Reanimate Goblin icon (mobile).png|left]]
'''Reanimate Goblin''' was a [[reanimation spell]] which required a [[Magic]] level of 3 and an [[ensouled goblin head]] to cast. This spell would summon a [[reanimated goblin]] with five Hitpoints.

Upon killing the reanimated goblin, players would gain 130 [[Prayer]] experience and 0.5% [[Arceuus]] [[favour]].

Reanimation can be cast on any ensouled head within an 31x31 area where that head was dropped by a monster. This work indefinitely, even if the ensouled head is picked up, so long as it is not put into the [[bank]], [[trade]] screen, [[Grand Exchange]], or [[price checker]]. If the player has put the head into the bank, trade screen, Grand Exchange, or price checker, the reanimation spell will only work within range of the [[Dark Altar]].
